decision.claim: Greater relative local nearest-neighbor spacing compared with two geometry references as Peromyscus genus MNKA increases; absolute spacing still contracts, and no territoriality or overdispersion mechanism identified
forbidden: claim genotypic species effect based on exploratory taxon split
select PELE only to reclassify genus confirmation
call the site-cluster CI prospectively valid after genus and null selection
claim adaptive segregation or social competition from 3-night trapping data
decision.recommended_next: Hold additional same-release post-hoc subgroup search; use first new NEON release with frozen genus test, and ideally independent tracking or a trap-specific detection-control design.
